{{small|(excluding matches played behind closed doors)}} | prevseason = [[2021 V.League 1|2021]] | nextseason = ''[[2023 V.League 1|2023]]'' | updated = complete | logo = V.League 1 (2022).png | season = 2022 | dates = 25 February – 19 November | runners-up = }} The '''2022 V.League 1''', known as the '''Night Wolf V.League 1''' ({{langx|vi|Giải bóng đá Vô địch Quốc gia Night Wolf 2022}}) for sponsorship reasons, was the 39th season of the [[V.League 1]], the highest division of [[Football in Vietnam|Vietnamese football]] and the 22nd as a professional league.{{cite web|title=Ngọc Linh Ginseng to sponsor national V.League 1|url=https://vietnamnews.vn/sports/1153890/ngoc-linh-ginseng-to-sponsor-national-vleague-1.html|access-date=11 February 2022}} The season started on 25 February 2022, and ended on 20 November.{{cite web|title=Vietnam's 2022 V-League 1 to kick off under new name|url=https://tuoitrenews.vn/news/sports/20220211/vietnams-2022-vleague-1-to-kick-off-under-new-name/65669.html|website=tuoitrenews.vn|date=11 February 2022 |access-date=11 February 2022}} There was no defending champion as a result of the [[2021 V.League 1|previous season]] being abandoned due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic in Vietnam|COVID-19 pandemic]]. There was a break from 14 March until 2 July to accommodate for the [[2022 FIFA World Cup qualification – AFC third round|2022 FIFA World Cup qualification]] and the delayed [[Football at the 2021 Southeast Asian Games|2021 Southeast Asian Games]]. [[Hanoi FC]] won their 6th league title on 13 November with one match to spare.{{cite web|title=Hà Nội win V.League 1 for record sixth time|url=https://vietnamnews.vn/sports/1395294/ha-noi-win-v-league-1-for-record-sixth-time.html|website=vietnamnews.vn|access-date=20 November 2022}} ==Changes from the previous season== Due to the previous season being abandoned, no teams were promoted or relegated from the 2021 season.{{cite web|title= Vietnamese football league cancelled amid COVID-19|url=https://vietnamnews.vn/sports/1020289/vietnamese-football-league-cancelled-amid-covid-19.html|website=vietnamnews.vn |access-date=19 October 2021}} All but one club from the [[2021 V.League 1|2021 season]] contested in the league. [[Than Quang Ninh FC|Than Quang Ninh]] were not permitted to participate due to financial reasons, leaving the league starting with just 13 clubs.{{cite web|title=Finances keep club from joining V. League 2022|url=https://e.vnexpress.net/news/sports/football/finances-keep-club-from-joining-v-league-2022-4378744.html|website=vnexpress.net|access-date=29 October 2021}} ===From V.League 1=== '''Dissolved''' * [[Than Quang Ninh FC|Than Quang Ninh]] ==Teams== {{location map+ |Vietnam |float=right |width=300 |caption=Locations of the '''2022 V.League 1''' teams |places= {{location map~ |Vietnam |lat=10.971839 |long=106.672614 |label_size=80|label=[[Becamex Binh Duong FC|{{nowrap|Becamex Binh Duong}}]] |position=right}} {{location map~ |Vietnam |lat=20.25 |long=106.25 |label_size=80|label={{nowrap|[[Nam Dinh FC]]}} |position=right}} {{location map~ |Vietnam |lat=21.030320 |long=105.832370 |label_size=80|label=Hanoi|mark=Blue pog.svg|position=left}} {{location map~ |Vietnam |lat=20.851355 |long=106.688478 |label_size=80|label={{nowrap|[[Haiphong FC]]}} |position=right}} {{location map~ |Vietnam |lat=13.978976 |long=108.004853 |label_size=80|label=[[Hoang Anh Gia Lai FC|{{nowrap|Hoang Anh Gia Lai}}]] |position=left}} {{location map~ |Vietnam |lat=18.333333 |long=105.9 |label_size=80|label=[[Hong Linh Ha Tinh FC|{{nowrap|Hong Linh Ha Tinh}}]] |position=right}} {{location map~ |Vietnam |lat=13.77417 |long=109.22811 |label_size=80|label=[[Binh Dinh FC|Topenland Binh Dinh]] |position=right}} {{location map~ |Vietnam |lat=16.069554 |long=108.216400 |label_size=80|label=[[SHB Danang FC|SHB Danang]] |position=right}} {{location map~ |Vietnam |lat=18.668851 |long=105.669538 |label_size=80|label=[[Song Lam Nghe An FC|{{nowrap|Song Lam Nghe An}}]] |position=right}} {{location map~ |Vietnam |lat=19.799342 |long=105.772713 |label_size=80|label=[[Thanh Hóa FC|{{nowrap|Dong A Thanh Hoa}}]] |position=right}} {{location map~ |Vietnam |lat=10.760659 |long=106.663320|label_size=80|label=
